label.purpose: Buttons, form labels, times and dates.

shadows.name: field-focus
shadows.purpose: Field focus glow with gold border.

motion.name: ambient-loops
motion.value: float 6s, sway 5.5s/4.8s, breathe 5s, twinkle 3.2s, glow 3.4s, spin 14s, shimmer 5s
motion.purpose: Transform/opacity only; all disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: petal-fall
motion.purpose: Falling petals; frozen at 0.55 opacity when reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Plum pill with gold-soft tracked caps label; submit action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--plum, #4a1d3b); color: var(--gold-soft, #f1d79a); border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 16px 24px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; box-shadow: 0 14px 24px -10px rgba(74,29,59,0.6); transition: opacity .2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: .92; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--plum, #4a1d3b); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Translucent white pill with plum outline for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: rgba(255,255,255,.4); color: var(--plum, #4a1d3b); border: 1px solid rgba(74,29,59,.4); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 14px 28px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background .2s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.7); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--plum, #4a1d3b); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Map Link
components.description: Terracotta-ink outlined pill link on day cards.
components.css: .ds-map { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid rgba(201,115,95,.5); color: var(--terracotta-ink, #a4513d); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 10px 16px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: background .2s; } .ds-map:hover { background: rgba(201,115,95,.1); } .ds-map:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--plum, #4a1d3b); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Soft white field with gold focus glow.
components.css: .ds-field { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; border: 1px solid var(--paper-edge, #f1d3d6); background: rgba(255,255,255,.72); border-radius: 14px; padding: 14px 16px; font-size: 16px; color: var(--plum, #4a1d3b); transition: border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s, background .2s; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: var(--mauve, #6b3f5c); opacity: 1; } .ds-field:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--gold, #b98a3a); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(185,138,58,.18); background: #fff; }

components.name: Day Card
components.description: Ivory-to-blush scroll card with terracotta frame and inset gold hairline.
components.css: .ds-day { position: relative; text-align: center; padding: 36px 28px 48px; border: 2px solid rgba(201,115,95,.7); border-radius: 30px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--ivory, #fff8f3), var(--blush, #fcecef)); box-shadow: 0 22px 34px -14px rgba(120,50,70,.35); color: var(--plum, #4a1d3b); } .ds-day::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(185,138,58,.6); border-radius: 23px; pointer-events: none; } .ds-day h3 { margin: 0; font-style: italic; font-size: 36px; line-height: 1; } .ds-day p { margin: 12px 0 0; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--rose-ink, #a04a4e); }

components.name: Attend Toggle
components.description: Segmented pill; selected segment is plum with gold-soft label.
components.css: .ds-toggle { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; padding: 4px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.7); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--paper-edge, #f1d3d6); } .ds-toggle button { border: 0; background: none; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 14px 6px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--plum-soft, #5d2d4d); } .ds-toggle .on { background: var(--plum, #4a1d3b); color: var(--gold-soft, #f1d79a); } .ds-toggle button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--plum, #4a1d3b); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: This is a new world, built from a user-supplied reference video, not an inherited system. Opening the invitation is the ritual: a sealed envelope opens into one continuous dusk-lit scroll in which each section is a different physical object. All art is hand-built placeholder SVG; gallery photos are the family's own; motion has a prefers-reduced-motion path; small text uses the ink tokens for contrast.
keyCharacteristics: Dusk gradient ground, paper cards, gold hairline inner frames
Arches, jharokha frames, tassels, torana, lanterns, petals, all authored SVG
Plum is the only action colour; gold is ornament and focus
Blurred, plum- or rose-tinted ambient shadows only
Gilda headings, Instrument Serif italic accents, Figtree small labels

rules.name: The Ink Twin Rule
rules.body: Text under 18px uses rose-ink, terracotta-ink, mauve or plum-soft. The bright rose and terracotta are for lines and fills only.

rules.name: The Gold Is Ornament Rule
rules.body: Gold marks frames, dividers, rods, focus and selected states. It is not the action colour; plum is.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Headings in Gilda, asides in Instrument Serif italic, functional text in Figtree. Do not add a fourth face.

rules.name: The Soft Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are blurred with a negative spread and tinted plum or rose; the fixed offsets are vertical.

dos: Do keep plum as the only action colour and gold as ornament.
Do use ink-twin tokens for any text under 18px.
Do build ornament as authored SVG in src/components/art/ and give every ambient animation a reduced-motion path.
Do animate only transform and opacity, with the ease-out curve cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1).
Do keep labels in tracked caps for functional text (buttons, field labels, times).
donts: Don't use bright rose or terracotta for small text.
Don't introduce hard-edged or black shadows.
Don't add faces beyond the three voices (plus Devanagari for Hindi).
Don't stack generic hero, feature-card and form blocks; each section is its own object.
